Rhea Kapoor: Postmortem follow-up: we need tight runbook edits for the recurring cache-eviction pattern. Three action areas: exact triage commands, explicit escalation path, and a temporary owner rotation for verification.
Ben Ortiz: Agree. Can we add a small decision tree at top: detect -> isolate -> validate canary -> failover? That reduced ambiguity last time.
Liam Park: I'll take triage commands + thresholds. Quick snippets to include:
```
# eviction rate
curl -sS http://metrics.internal/kvcache?model=abc | jq .evictions_per_min
# prefix size
curl -sS http://metrics.internal/kvcache?model=abc | jq .prefix_size_mb
# canary probe
curl -sS http://canary.inference/v1/predict -d '{"prompt":"ping"}' | jq .status
```
Suggested thresholds: evictions_per_min >= 80 -> start triage; >=180 -> page runtime lead; prefix_size_mb > 500 -> consider shard isolation.
Rhea Kapoor: Perfect. Ben, can you draft the escalation sequence text (who to page at each threshold) and add the exact copy/paste paging lines?
Ben Ortiz: Will do. Proposal: oncall -> runtime lead -> infra oncall -> eng manager. Include pager IDs and sample message. Due 2026-04-02.
runbook-bot: Created RB-4620 "Cache eviction runbook edits: triage commands + escalation matrix + owner rotation" assigned to Liam Park (triage commands) and Ben Ortiz (escalation text). Due 2026-04-02.
Liam Park: I'll push edits to guarded branch runbook/incident-2421234567-patch and add a short QA checklist: staging dry-run, simulate eviction, verify revert commands. Due 2026-04-02.
Rhea Kapoor: Also add a short "recurrence notes" section linking prior incidents 2409001111 and 2412002222 so reviewers know it's a pattern. After PR merges, we'll mark the postmortem action as complete. Ping this thread with PR/ticket links. :white_check_mark:
